title: German Sweet Potato Dumplings
description: Pillowy sweet potato dumplings infused with herbal flavors, deep-fried to a crispy golden brown, served as a romantic German dish, jain-friendly and delicious.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the mashed sweet potatoes, flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, and nutmeg, mixing well.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small dumplings, about 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees.
When the oil is hot, add a few dumplings to the pan, being careful not to overcrowd.
Fry the dumplings until they are golden brown, about 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the dumplings from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
